mapper.select: SELECT rm.room_id AS roomId, ( SELECT c.message FROM chat c WHERE c.room_id = rm.room_id ORDER BY c.chat_id DESC LIMIT 1 ) AS lastMessage, ( SELECT c.chat_at FROM chat c WHERE c.room_id = rm.room_id ORDER BY c.chat_id DESC LIMIT 1 ) AS lastChatAt FROM room_members rm WHERE rm.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY COALESCE(lastChatAt, '1970-01-01') DESC
SELECT user_id FROM room_members rm WHERE room_id = #{roomId} ORDER BY user_id
